prompt: Produce ONE transparent 2D fighting-game sprite atlas, exactly TWO COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, portrait canvas 2:3. LEFT column: TRUE DEEP FIGHTING CROUCH, knees folded sharply, hips dropped almost to heels, both boot soles visibly planted at same baseline, torso low leaning slightly forward, two closed fists protecting head. RIGHT column: SAME DEEP CROUCH with one fist extended horizontally right at knee/waist height, rear fist guarding cheek: a crouching low punch, never a standing punch. Character heads retain their normal round proportions, never squash or stretch the entire figure. Full folded knees and both feet must be visible, clear crouched silhouette. Same character SCALE and foot baseline between both poses in each row. Each character stays inside its own cell with 12% transparent side margins; no overlap or clipping. Whole tail, horns, hair, fists, shoes visible. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no scenery, floor, shadow, effects, speech bubbles, text, numbers, watermark or checkerboard. Single six-cell atlas specifically for CROUCH and CROUCH PUNCH.
